description: Find new video games Creative Cult follows, by name. Returns each game's release date, the latest share of player reviews that recommend it with its date, and a link to its page. Games with a slug have a full report you can read with get_game. Leave the query empty to list every game with a report, newest first.

query.description: Part of a game's name, such as "wolverine".

name: search_games

recommend.description: The share of player reviews that recommend the game, and the day they were counted.

title: Search games
